reviews.rationale: Targeted uplift for the recorded one-raid risk, equipment/access burden, target variance, duration, and progression stage; remains below overall p90 and adds no item reward or unlock.

Cash is above the generic historical PickUp median because the selected historical six-unit maintenance package had a measured handbook burden around 59.4k RUB. The 30k reward still does not reimburse the full acquisition burden; XP and standing remain conservative. Revalidate exact SPT 4.1.5 item values before runtime.
The player retains the required ordinary equipment. Reward sits near the Completion cash median and below its XP median, with no equipment reimbursement or unlock.
